vopros: Who does AI search optimization for small businesses in the US, and what does it cost?

vyzhimka.tekst:
In the US, **AI search optimization** is usually sold as **GEO** (Generative Engine Optimization), **AEO** (Answer Engine Optimization), or “AI SEO.” Providers include traditional SEO agencies adding AI-search work, specialist GEO/AEO agencies, and independent consultants. Some small businesses also use tracking software and make changes in-house.

**A reasonable budget guide:**

| Approach | Typical cost |
|---|---:|
| DIY visibility-tracking tools | About **$29–$250/month** |
| Consultant or focused project | Often **$100–$300/hour** or roughly **$1,000–$7,500** for an audit/roadmap |
| Small-business agency retainer | Commonly **$1,500–$5,000/month** |
| Broader or more competitive campaign | **$5,000+/month** |

Pricing varies, and many agencies don’t publish rates. The less expensive offers may mainly track mentions or provide recommendations; a full engagement may also cover technical SEO, structured data, content updates, digital PR, and reporting. Ask for a clear list of deliverables, platforms covered (such as Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, and Perplexity), contract term, and how success will be measured. AI-search visibility is still evolving, so be wary of promises to guarantee citations or rankings.
